headline: WONDER ATTACK drop pre-debut MV 'Ready To Dive'
sub: New 8-member boy group from MME says hello
caption:
WONDER ATTACK have released the MV for their pre-debut single 'Ready To Dive'.

The eight-member boy group from MME (Macaroni Music Entertainment) dropped the single on Nov 23, a future bass track with hyperpop synths, after meeting fans at their first mini fan meeting on Nov 22. The lineup includes Park Jun Il, who debuted as a solo artist in April. Official debut details haven't been announced yet.

📌 Source: MME, via Korean media (iMBC)
